# FounderReach AI
> The Autonomous Growth & Discoverability Agent for Founders

## Overview
FounderReach AI is an autonomous growth platform that audits websites for SEO (Search Engine Optimization), AEO (Answer Engine Optimization), and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), generates structured deployment scripts (Schema.org JSON-LD, /llms.txt, FAQPage), and scans community channels (Reddit, Hacker News) for active customer buyer demand.

## Core Services & Architectures
- **Autonomous Technical Sentinel**: Inspects DNS, TLS 1.3, Robots crawl boundaries, and latencies.
- **Multi-Surface Perception Modeling**: Simulates how Google Search, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Perplexity perceive any startup domain.
- **Fix Synthesis Studio**: Generates 1-click copyable Schema.org JSON-LD, /llms.txt, and meta tags.
- **Customer Demand Discovery Radar**: Discovers active buyer discussions on Reddit (e.g. r/SideProject, r/SaaS) and Hacker News with non-spam founder playbooks.

## Pricing Philosophy
Transparent and accessible for bootstrapped founders:
- Free Diagnostic: $0 forever
- Autonomous Growth Agent: $12/month or $29 One-Time Lifetime per project
- Growth Operations: $49/month for agencies and multi-project founders
